scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Milk, Cheese,
Old Frying Pans,
Pieces of Cake...
Th-that's everything
I need to make lunch for
my friends in the Factory!
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
牛奶、乳酪、破舊平底鍋、蛋糕塊...
這...這些就是我為工廠裡的朋友們做午餐所需的全部食材了！

scripts.text: Well, I did promise to help you.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我答應過要幫你的

scripts.text: What are you talking about?
scripts.translation: 你在說什麼？

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Finally, I can treat my
buddies to a wonderful
feast! They'll be so pleased!
Oh, I'd really like to repay you
somehow, but I'm not sure
what I could possibly give...
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
太好了，我終於可以請我的夥伴們享用一頓豐盛的午餐了！
他們一定會很開心的！
啊，我真想好好報答你，但我不確定能給你什麼...

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Of course! Why don't
you treat yourself to
my specialty, Kasis's
Crunch Toast? It looks
simple, but it actually
requires great skill to make.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
當然！不如你嚐嚐我的拿手好戲，卡西斯的土司吧？它看起來很簡單，但其實製作起來非常考驗技巧。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Here you are!
Please enjoy this and always
remember that breakfast is the
most important meal of the day!
Now, I better prepare those
lunches. Goodbye, my friend~
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
給你！
請享用，並永遠記住早餐是一天中最重要的一餐！
好了，我得去準備午餐了。
再見，我的朋友~

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Oh...
Oh, I'm so sorry.
I must have confused
you with someone else.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
啊...
啊，真對不起。
我一定是把你和別的人搞混了。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
You see, I've been asking
adventurers that have been
passing through to provide
me with food supplies so that
I can make lunch for my friends
that are working in Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
你看，我一直在請求路過的冒險者為我提供食材，這樣我就能為在艾音布羅克工廠工作的朋友們做午餐了。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Yes...
So...
Sorry...
To... Bother you.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
是的...
所以...
抱歉...
打擾...你了。

scripts.text:
^3355FFAs if entranced,
Kasis continues to
stare at the Milk, Cheese
Old Frying Pans and Pieces
of Cake that you are carrying.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF卡西斯彷彿著了魔一般，一直盯著你攜帶的牛奶、乳酪、破舊平底鍋和蛋糕塊看。^000000

scripts.text: You can have these if you want.
scripts.translation: 如果你想要的話，這些給你吧

scripts.text: Um, why are you staring?
scripts.translation: 嗯，你為什麼一直盯著看？

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Really? Is it alright
with you for me to have
all of this Milk, Cheese,
Pieces of Cake and these
Old Frying Pans? Oh, bless
your kind heart, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
真的嗎？你願意把這些牛奶、乳酪、蛋糕塊和破舊平底鍋都給我嗎？
啊，謝謝你，心地善良的冒險者~

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Finally, I can treat my
buddies to a wonderful
feast! They'll be so pleased!
Oh, I'd really like to repay you
somehow, but I'm not sure
what I could possibly give...
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
太好了，我終於可以請我的夥伴們享用一頓豐盛的午餐了！
他們一定會很開心的！
啊，我真想好好報答你，但我不確定能給你什麼...

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Of course! Why don't
you treat yourself to
my specialty, Kasis's
Crunch Toast? It looks
simple, but it actually
requires great skill to make.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
當然！不如你嚐嚐我的拿手好戲，卡西斯的土司吧？它看起來很簡單，但其實製作起來非常考驗技巧。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Here you are!
Please enjoy this and always
remember that breakfast is the
most important meal of the day!
Now, I better prepare those
lunches. Goodbye, my friend~
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
給你！
請享用，並永遠記住早餐是一天中最重要的一餐！
好了，我得去準備午餐了。
再見，我的朋友~

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Oh, let me apologize
again. But I can't help
but admire the quality of
your goods. Er, you know,
the food you're carrying. I'm
a chef by trade, after all.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
啊，讓我再向你道歉一次。
但我忍不住要誇讚一下你貨物的品質。呃，你知道的，就是你攜帶的那些食物。畢竟我是個廚師。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
I'm sorry, but we're closed
right now. Unfortunately, we
don't have any more bread
in stock. ^333333*Siiiiiiiiigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
很抱歉，我們現在已經打烊了。
不幸的是，我們的麵包已經賣光了。^333333*唉...*^000000

scripts.text: Is something wrong?
scripts.translation: 出什麼事了嗎？

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Well, my current contract
with the company that's been
providing me with ingredients
has expired. Of course, it's
bad enough that I don't have
the food to run this business.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
嗯，我和一直為我提供食材的公司之間的契約已經到期了。
當然，沒有食物來維持這家店的經營已經很糟糕了。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
But I also feel like I'm
letting my friends down.
You see, I've been sending
them lunch every day since
they've been working in the
Factory over in Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
但我也覺得自己在辜負我的朋友們。
你看，自從他們在艾音布羅克的工廠工作以來，我每天都給他們送午餐。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
I'm unable to make
lunch for them at the
moment, but I really want to
help my buddies, especially
since their financial situation
seems pretty bad right now.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
我現在無法為他們做午餐了，但我真的很想幫助我的夥伴們，特別是他們現在的經濟狀況似乎很糟糕。

scripts.text: Do you want me to help you?
scripts.translation: 需要我幫你嗎？

scripts.text: I'm so sorry to hear that.
scripts.translation: 聽到這個我很難過

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Sure, I'm willing to accept
help from wherever I can find
it. If you would, I'd like you to bring me some food supplies
that I can use to make lunches
for my friends at the Factory.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
當然，我願意接受任何能找到的幫助。
如果可以的話，希望你能幫我帶一些食材，這樣我就能為工廠裡的朋友們做午餐了。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Would you
please get me
^4D4DFF50 Milk^000000,
^4D4DFF50 Cheese^000000,
^4D4DFF50 Pieces of Cake^000000 and
^4D4DFF50 Old Frying Pans^000000?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
請幫我弄來^4D4DFF50瓶牛奶^000000、^4D4DFF50塊乳酪^000000、^4D4DFF50個蛋糕塊^000000和^4D4DFF50個破舊平底鍋^000000，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
I'd really appreciate
your help. My friends seem
so depressed to be working
in the Factory and I want to
do all I can to cheer them up.
Thanks for your kind offer~
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
非常感謝你的幫助。我的朋友們在工廠工作看起來很沮喪，我想盡我所能讓他們開心起來。
謝謝你的好意~

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
I'm trying to renew
my contract with the
company that's been
providing me with food
supplies, but it hasn't
been working out so far...
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
我正在嘗試與一直為我提供食材的公司續約，但到目前為止進展不太順利...

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
I don't know what's
happening, but hopefully
I can find a new supplier
soon. There are my friends
to worry about, as well as
the sake of my business.
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
我不知道發生了什麼，但希望我很快能找到新的供應商。我不僅要擔心我的朋友們，還要為了我的生意著想。

scripts.text:
[Kasis]
Anyway, please come
again. Hopefully, we'll
have some good bread
in stock next time, okay?
scripts.translation:
[卡西斯]
總之，請再來吧。希望下次我們會有好吃的麵包存貨，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Strange Guy]
Wait! Don't say
anything! You must be
an adventurer from the
Rune-Midgarts Kingdom!
So... I'm right, aren't I?
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的傢伙]
等等！別說話！你一定是來自盧恩·米德加茲王國的冒險者！
所以...我猜對了吧？

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是誰？

scripts.text: How did you know?
scripts.translation: 你怎麼知道的？

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 無視他

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Allow me to
introduce myself.
My name is Morris Poe,
detective of great acclaim
and world wide fame.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
請允許我自我介紹。
我叫莫里斯·坡，享譽盛名、名揚四海的偵探。

scripts.text: I've never heard of you.
scripts.translation: 我從未聽說過你

scripts.text: You're kidding me.
scripts.translation: 你在開玩笑吧

scripts.text: I'm outta here.
scripts.translation: 我要走了

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Morris Poe?
Renown detective?
Advocate for justice in
the Schwarzwald Republic?
Surely you recognize one
of my esteemed titles.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
莫里斯·坡？
著名的偵探？
修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國的正義捍衛者？
你肯定能認出我的其中一個頭銜吧。

scripts.text: Nope, I don't know you.
scripts.translation: 不，我不認識你

scripts.text: You're Morris Poe?!
scripts.translation: 你是莫里斯·坡？！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
You don't...?
But I'm a famous hero.
Children look up to me
and wish they'd grow
up to be as smart as me.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
你不...？
但我可是個著名的英雄。
孩子們都崇拜我，希望長大後能像我一樣聰明。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
I don't get it.
I'm famouser than
that. A household name
even. I've got a sterling
public image, how could
you never have heard of me...?
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
我不明白。
我比那還要有名。
甚至是家喻戶曉的名字。
我的公眾形象無可挑剔，你怎麼可能從未聽說過我...？

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Kidding? Ha ha!
Look at these keen,
deductive and deeply
analytical eyes and
tell me I'm joking.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
開玩笑？哈哈！
看看我這雙敏銳、善於推理且分析透徹的眼睛，告訴我我在開玩笑。

scripts.text: Whoa, those ARE keen eyes.
scripts.translation: 哇，那確實是雙敏銳的眼睛

scripts.text: Okay. You're joking.
scripts.translation: 好吧。你在開玩笑

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Yes, this sharp,
penetrating, yet
highly intelligent gaze
belongs to the world
detective and crime
fighter, Morris Poe!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
是的，這雙銳利、洞察力強且極具智慧的目光，屬於世界偵探兼犯罪剋星，莫里斯·坡！

scripts.text: I've never heard of you.
scripts.translation: 我從未聽說過你

scripts.text: Golly, Morris Poe?!
scripts.translation: 天哪，莫里斯·坡？！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Never heard of...?
Impossible! If there are
two things I hate more
than crime, they would be
dishonesty... And rejection
from beautiful women.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
從未聽說過...？
不可能！如果有什麼比犯罪更讓我討厭的，那就是不誠實...還有被美麗的女性拒絕。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
When you get over your
sense of pride and gain
a little maturity, then we
might share an actual
conversation. Until then,
you'll just have to grow up.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
等你放下你的自尊心，變得稍微成熟一點，我們也許就能進行真正的對話了。在那之前，你最好先長大成人。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Hahahahahaah--Huh.
If there are two things
I hate more than criminals,
they would be sarcasm...
And receiving fake phone
numbers from really cute girls.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
哈哈哈哈——嗯。
如果有什麼比罪犯更讓我討厭的，那就是諷刺...還有收到真正可愛的女孩給的假電話號碼。

scripts.text: Yeah, you're no Don Juan.
scripts.translation: 是啊，你可不是唐·璜

scripts.text: I'm... I'm sorry.
scripts.translation: 我...我很抱歉

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Wah...!
Did you just--?!
Ugh, you're the worst
type of person, you know that?
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
哇...！
你剛才...？！
唉，你知道你這種人最糟糕嗎？

scripts.text:
[Morris]
I think it's too late to
apologize. Why would you
treat someone of my stature
with such caustic sarcasm?!
What excuse could possibly
exonerate your behavior?!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
我覺得現在道歉已經太晚了。你為什麼要用如此尖刻的諷刺來對待像我這樣地位的人？！
有什麼藉口能證明你的行為是無辜的嗎？！

scripts.text: I... I was intimidated...
scripts.translation: 我...我很害怕...

scripts.text: It's how I treat all losers.
scripts.translation: 這就是我對所有失敗者的態度

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Of course: intense feelings
of awe and fear of my vast
intellect would result in that
kind of deviant behavior. I'll
have to forgive you, I suppose.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
當然：對我淵博學識的敬畏和恐懼導致了這種反常舉動。我想我還是得原諒你吧。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
What...?!
Morris Poe, a loser?
Such defamatory remarks
cannot be forgiven, no
matter how unfounded
and groundless they are!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
什麼...？！
莫里斯·坡，一個失敗者？
這種誹謗性的言論是絕對不能被原諒的，無論它多麼毫無根據！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Hahaha, oh, that's
funny. Wait. You're...
You're really leaving.
N-no, come baaaack!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
哈哈，哦，這真有趣。等等。你是...
你真的要走了。
不...不，回...回來！

scripts.text:
[Strange Guy]
How did I know?
Elementary, my friend.
There was an abundance
of clues for me to make
that sort of simple deduction.
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的傢伙]
我怎麼會知道？
很簡單，我的朋友。
有大量的線索讓我做出了這種簡單的推理。

scripts.text:
[Strange Guy]
Hello...?
...............
Oh, this is embarassing.
I can't believe I'm getting
the silent treatment...
scripts.translation:
[奇怪的傢伙]
你好...？
...............
哦，這太尷尬了。
我簡直不敢相信我正在被冷遇...

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Yes, I know it's
difficult to believe that
you would be fortunate
enough to stand in the
presence of genius. Now,
you must be wondering...
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
是的，我知道很難相信你有幸能站在天才面前。現在，你一定在想...

scripts.text: Um, wondering what?
scripts.translation: 嗯，在想什麼？

scripts.text:
[Morris]
You're wondering,
"How in the world
can I be as brilliant
as Morris Poe, the
genius detective?"
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
你在想，“我怎麼可能像天才偵探莫里斯·坡一樣聰明？”

scripts.text:
[Morris]
First, I think it's fair
to let you know that it's
an impossible dream. Men like
myself only arise in this world
perhaps once every generation.
I'm sorry, but don't give up!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
首先，我覺得讓你知道這是一個不可能的夢想是公平的。像我這樣的人，在這個世界上一代可能只會出現一次。
很抱歉，但不要放棄！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Now, you can try to reach
a level of intelligence that
is comparable to my own by
joining the Young Detective's
Club. To become a member, you just need one essential article.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
現在，你可以通過加入少年偵探社來嘗試達到與我相當的智慧水平。要成為會員，你只需要一件必備物品。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Yes, you will need the
^0000FFRenown Detective's Cap^000000!
Luckily, I'm giving them
away for a relatively small
material cost, but you must
hurry while supplies last.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
是的，你需要^0000FF偵探之帽^000000！
幸運的是，我只收取相對低廉的材料費，但你要抓緊，數量有限。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Simply bring me
^0000FF10 Magnifiers^000000,
^0000FF1887 Tassels^000000,
^0000FF1 Slotted Bucket Hat^000000
and ^0000FF1,887 zeny^000000. That's all!

[Morris]
But first, let me warn you
not to bring a ^FF0000slotted Bucket
Hat with a card compounded to
it, or any upgraded Bucket Hats. I'm not responsible for any
loss resulting from that.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
不過首先，我要提醒你，不要攜帶^FF0000帶有插槽且鑲嵌了卡片的軟呢帽，或者任何升級過的軟呢帽。如果因此造成損失，我概不負責。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Hurry and bring me
those items! There are
only 20,000,000 Renown
Detective Caps left!
Once they're gone,
they'll be extinct!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
快把那些物品帶給我！
只剩下20,000,000頂偵探之帽了！
一旦賣完，就絕版了！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
So, did you want to
buy, er, receive this
Renown Detective's Cap
and become an honored
member of the Young
Detective's Club?
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
那麼，你是想購買，呃，領取這頂偵探之帽，併成為少年偵探社的榮譽成員嗎？

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Remember, make sure
that you don't bring any
^FF0000slotted Bucket Hats that
have been upgraded or have
cards compounded to them, or
you'll lose those enhancements^000000.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
記住，確保你帶來的^FF0000軟呢帽沒有升級，也沒有鑲嵌卡片^000000，否則你會失去那些強化效果。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Now, if you have only
1 Bucket Hat, we can begin.
Young Detective's Club... Salute!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
現在，如果你只有1頂軟呢帽，我們可以開始了。
少年偵探社...敬禮！

scripts.text: Salute.
scripts.translation: 敬禮

scripts.text: Whatever...
scripts.translation: 隨便吧...

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Great, done like a pro!
Now, I need to check your
fee--I mean qualifications.
Let's see now, I need to
look through your Inventory...
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
很好，做得像專業人士一樣！
現在，我需要檢查你的費用——我是說資格。
讓我看看，我需要翻查一下你的物品欄...

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Wait. You don't have
enough Magnifiers. You
do want to join this club,
don't you? Did you need to
hear the requirements again?
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
等等。你的放大鏡不夠。
你是想加入這個社團的，對吧？需要我再說一遍要求嗎？

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Not enough Tassels? Check.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大鏡。有。
流蘇不夠？有。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Tassels... Check.
Hm. You're missing
the slotted Bucket Hat.
You were so close...
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大鏡。有。
流蘇...有。
嗯。你缺少軟呢帽。
你差一點就成功了...

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Tassels... Check.
Slotted Bucket Hat. Got it.
Hey. Where's the zeny?!
That's the most important,
er, qualification of all!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大鏡。有。
流蘇...有。
軟呢帽。有。
嘿。Zeny呢？！
那是最重要的，呃，資格之一！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
^333333*Sigh*^000000 You need
^0000FF10 Magnifiers^000000,
^0000FF1887 Tassels^000000,
^0000FF1 Slotted Bucket Hat^000000
and ^0000FF1,887 zeny^000000. That's all!

[Morris]
Now, remember everything
that you need this time, okay?
I'll be waiting to welcome
you into the elite ranks of 
the Young Detective's Club.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
現在，這次記住你需要的所有東西，好嗎？
我會在這裡等待，歡迎你加入少年偵探社的精英行列。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Tassels... Check.
Slotted Bucket Hat. Got it.
Aaaand zeny. Heh heh. Perfect.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大鏡。有。
流蘇...有。
軟呢帽。有。
還有Zeny。嘿嘿。完美。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Great, that's everything!
Welcome to the club! Here's
your Renown Detective's Cap,
so wear it with pride as you
take an active part in our club's
activities and promotion!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
很好，都齊了！
歡迎加入社團！這是你的偵探之帽，請自豪地戴上它，積極參與我們社團的活動和宣傳！

scripts.text: Wait, promotion?
scripts.translation: 等等，宣傳？

scripts.text: Hooray!
scripts.translation: 萬歲！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Of course, isn't it obvious?
As a member, one of your duties
will be to sing accolades of this club so that more members
will join and earn their own
Renown Detective's Caps.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
當然，這不是顯而易見的嗎？
作為成員，你的職責之一就是歌頌這個社團，以便吸引更多成員加入，並獲得他們自己的偵探之帽。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Alright, scurry off
now and proudly display
your new, rakishly stylish
Renown Detective's Cap
to all of your friends!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
好了，快去吧！
向你的朋友們炫耀一下你那頂嶄新、瀟灑又帥氣的偵探之帽吧！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Alright, scurry off
now and proudly display
your new, rakishly stylish
Renown Detective's Cap
to all of your friends!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
好了，快去吧！
向你的朋友們炫耀一下你那頂嶄新、瀟灑又帥氣的偵探之帽吧！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Huh. You just failed
the "Test of Respect."
You don't deserve the
honor of wearing the
Renowned Detective's Cap!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
哼。你剛才沒有通過“尊重測試”。
你不配擁有佩戴偵探之帽的榮譽！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Have you come to me
in order to obtain another
Renown Detective's Cap?
I realize that such a stylish
headgear is in high demand.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
你是來找我再獲取一頂偵探之帽的嗎？
我知道這種時尚的頭飾非常搶手。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Remember, make sure
that you don't bring any
^FF0000slotted Bucket Hats that
have been upgraded or have
cards compounded to them, or
you'll lose those enhancements^000000.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
記住，確保你帶來的^FF0000軟呢帽沒有升級，也沒有鑲嵌卡片^000000，否則你會失去那些強化效果。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
As a proud member of
the Young Detective's Club,
did you bring everything
you need in order to earn
a Renown Detective's Cap?
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
作為少年偵探社自豪的一員，你帶齊了獲得偵探之帽所需的所有東西了嗎？

scripts.text: I'm not sure~
scripts.translation: 我不太確定~

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
What...?! Every good
detective must have a
photographic memory
and be able to recall
minute details in order
to crack the case.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
什...什麼？！
優秀的偵探必須擁有過目不忘的記憶力，並能回憶起細微的細節，才能破案。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Remember...
^0000FF10 Magnifiers^000000,
^0000FF1887 Tassels^000000,
^0000FF1 Slotted Bucket Hat^000000
and ^0000FF1,887 zeny^000000. Okay?

[Morris]
Great!
Now let me just
check to see if you
brought everything...
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
很好！
現在讓我檢查一下你是否帶齊了所有東西...

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Hmm, you don't have
enough Magnifiers? But
those are essential tools
for sleuthing. Come now,
hurry back with them!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
嗯，你的放大鏡不夠嗎？但那是偵探必不可少的工具。
快去吧，趕緊把它們帶回來！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Not enough Tassels? Check.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大鏡。有。
流蘇不夠？有。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Tassels... Check.
Hm. You're missing
the slotted Bucket Hat.
You were so close...
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大鏡。有。
流蘇...有。
嗯。你缺少軟呢帽。
你差一點就成功了...

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Tassels... Check.
Slotted Bucket Hat. Got it.
Hey. Where's the zeny?!
That's the most important,
er, qualification of all!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大鏡。有。
流蘇...有。
軟呢帽。有。
嘿。Zeny呢？！
那是最重要的，呃，資格之一！

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Remember...
^0000FF10 Magnifiers^000000,
^0000FF1887 Tassels^000000,
^0000FF1 Slotted Bucket Hat^000000
and ^0000FF1,887 zeny^000000. Okay?

[Morris]
Magnifiers. Check.
Tassels... Check.
Slotted Bucket Hat. Got it.
Aaaand zeny. Heh heh. Perfect.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
放大鏡。有。
流蘇...有。
軟呢帽。有。
還有Zeny。嘿嘿。完美。

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Great! You've just qualified
to own yet another Renowned
Detective's Cap. Congratulations! Now, let me collect all of these
goods and zeny from you...
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
很好！你剛剛獲得了擁有另一頂偵探之帽的資格。
恭喜！現在，讓我把這些物品和Zeny收起來...

scripts.text:
[Morris]
Hahaha! It's what
I expect from one of
our Junior Gold Members!
How does it feel like to be
the cream of the cream of
the crop? Great, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
哈哈！這正是我對我們“黃金會員”的期待！
成為頂尖中的頂尖，感覺如何？很棒，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hello, mister!
Um, would you do
me a favor, please?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
你好，先生！
那個，能請你幫我個忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hello, ma'am!
Um, would you do
me a favor, please?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
你好，女士！
那個，能請你幫我個忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Oh! You brought me
some Royal Jelly to
eat, as well as everything
I need to make a Baby Pacifier.
Okay, let me get started on that right away. Just a moment...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哦！你不僅給我帶了蜂膠吃，還帶齊了製作小孩奶嘴所需的一切。
好的，我馬上開始做。請稍等...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Damn.
That Royal Jelly
was frickin' delicious!
Now I can make your
Baby Pacifier. Let's see
here. Ah, here we go...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
該死。
那蜂膠真是美味極了！
現在我可以為你製作小孩奶嘴了。讓我看看。
啊，開始了...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
It's done!
Now, you're the
proud owner of your
very own Baby Pacifier!
I hope you're happy with
yourself. Travel safe, okay?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
完成了！
現在，你擁有了屬於自己的小孩奶嘴！
希望你滿意。一路順風，好嗎？

scripts.text: What do you need?
scripts.translation: 你需要什麼？

scripts.text: Sorry, kid...
scripts.translation: 抱歉，小傢伙...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Well, my mom has been
sick recently, so both of
us haven't been able to eat
for the past few days. But
if she doesn't eat, how does
she expect to get better?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嗯，我媽媽最近生病了，所以我們好幾天都沒吃東西了。
但如果她不吃東西，怎麼能好起來呢？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
So I guess what I'm
asking is, would you be
able to spare some food?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
所以我想問的是，你能分我一點食物嗎？

scripts.text: Help him.
scripts.translation: 幫助他

scripts.text: Refuse to help.
scripts.translation: 拒絕幫助

scripts.text:
[Kid]
If you would, do you think
you can get some Royal Jelly
that I can give to my mom? The old lady next door says that it's
really nutritious and helps you get better faster if you're sick.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
如果可以的話，你能幫我弄點蜂膠嗎？
我想給我媽媽吃。
隔壁的老太太說，蜂膠營養很好，生病的時候吃了能好得快一些。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
My mom would be mad
at me if she found out
I was begging for it, but
Royal Jelly is too expensive
for me to get without any help!
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
如果我媽媽知道我在求人幫忙，她肯定會生氣的，但蜂膠對我來說太貴了，不靠別人我根本買不起！

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Oh, would it be alright
if I have this Royal Jelly?
It would really help my mom
feel better. Thanks so much~
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
啊，那我可以收下這個蜂膠嗎？
它真的能讓我媽媽感覺好一些。太感謝了~

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Hey, to pay you back, why
don't I make a Baby Pacifier
for you? I learned how to make
one when my baby brother was
born. But first, I'll need some
materials to put it together...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
嘿，為了報答你，我為你做一個小孩奶嘴吧？
我弟弟出生時，我學會了怎麼做。
不過首先，我需要一些材料來組裝它...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Would you
please bring
^3131FF1 Nursing Bottle^000000,
^3131FF1 Nose Ring^000000 and
^3131FF1 Pacifier^000000? Oh, and one
more ^3131FFRoyal Jelly^000000 for me~
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
請幫我帶^3131FF1個嬰兒的奶瓶^000000、^3131FF1個牛鼻環^000000和^3131FF1個小孩奶嘴^000000好嗎？
哦，再給我一個^3131FF蜂膠^000000~

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Oh... Um, that's
alright. Maybe I was
asking too much from
you. I mean, it's true
that you barely know me...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
哦...嗯，沒關係。也許是我要求太多了。
畢竟，你幾乎不認識我...

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Th-that's okay.
I guess you must
be so busy that you
don't even have the
time to listen to some
little boy's problems...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
那...那好吧。
我想你一定很忙，連聽一個小男孩煩惱的時間都沒有...

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Oh, hello, what's this?
You're carrying 1 Black
Dyestuffs, 1 Frozen Rose,
999 Tiger Panties and even
50,000 zeny with you. That's
enough to make a Winter Hat...
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
哦，你好，這是什麼？
你身上帶著1個黑色染料、1朵冰雕玫瑰、999條老虎內褲，甚至還有50,000 Zeny。
這些足夠做一頂時尚防寒帽了...

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Um, would you mind letting
me have those items so that
I can make a Winter Hat?
I'd never be able to gather
those things on my own...
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
嗯，你介意把這些材料給我嗎？
這樣我就能做一頂時尚防寒帽了。
我自己根本湊不齊這些東西...

scripts.text: Let her have the items.
scripts.translation: 把材料給她

scripts.text: Don't give her the items.
scripts.translation: 不給材料

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Oh, thank you so much!
I've always wanted to make
this hat and try it on, even
if it's just once. But don't
worry, I'll give it to you~
Now please next; a moment...
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
哦，太感謝了！
我一直想做這頂帽子並試戴一下，哪怕只有一次也好。
不過別擔心，我會把它給你的~
那麼請等一下，稍候片刻...

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Let's see...
I've got to fold
the rose like this...
Be careful with the dye...
Where did I put all those
pan--Oh, here we are.
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
讓我看看...
我得把玫瑰這樣摺疊...
小心染料...
我把那些內——哦，在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
^333333*Whew!*^000000
Finally, it's done!
Now, if you don't mind,
let me try this hat on
for just a little while.
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
^333333*呼！^000000
終於做好了！
如果你不介意的話，讓我先試戴這頂帽子一小會兒。

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Ahhhhhh~
It just feels...
I felt so free~
It was everything
I imagined it to be.
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
啊~~~~~
感覺就是...
我感到無比自由~
它完全就是我想像中的樣子。

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Here, please take
this Winter Hat. I really
hope that you'll enjoy it
as much as I do. Well then,
be safe in your travels, okay?
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
請收下這頂時尚防寒帽。
我真的希望你能像我一樣喜歡它。
那麼，旅途平安，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
I'm sorry, I know that
I was asking a pretty big
favor from someone I just
met. I hope you understand
how much I really want to
make that Winter Hat...
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
對不起，我知道我剛才向一個剛認識的人提出了很大的請求。
希望你能理解我有多想做那頂時尚防寒帽...

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Look at that blue
sky. Don't you wish
you could just soar
through the heavens
with your own wings?
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
看那片藍天。
你不希望能長出翅膀，在天空中翱翔嗎？

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
Of course, it's an
impossible dream,
but with this Winter Hat,
you can at least enjoy the
sensation of freedom that
a bird in flight must feel.
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
當然，這是一個不可能的夢想，但戴上這頂時尚防寒帽，你至少能感受到鳥兒飛翔時那種自由的感覺。

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
If you would like
a hat like this, I would
need to have some items
that I don't think I can ever
obtain on my very own.
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
如果您想要一頂這樣的帽子，我需要一些材料，但我認為憑我自己是永遠也弄不到的。

scripts.text:
[Metelle]
^FF00001 Black Dyestuffs^000000,
^FF0000999 Tiger Panties^000000,
^FF00001 Frozen Rose^000000 and
^FF000050,000 zeny^000000. If you can
bring those to me, I shall
make you a Winter Hat.
scripts.translation:
[梅特勒]
^FF00001個黑色染料^000000，^FF0000999個老虎內褲^000000，^FF00001個冰雕玫瑰^000000 以及^FF000050,000 Zeny^000000。
如果您能將這些帶給我，我就為您製作一頂時尚防寒帽。

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
The white rose, in its
purity and simplicity, is
like a woman who doesn't
need jewels or fancy dresses
to look noble and beautiful. It's the perfect gift for a lady.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特·瑪麗]
白玫瑰以其純潔與簡約，宛如一位無需珠寶或華服便能顯得高貴美麗的淑女。
它是送給女士的完美禮物。

scripts.text: Make a Mystic Rose.
scripts.translation: 製作水靈玫瑰

scripts.text: End Conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
Ah, I see that you've brought
what I need to bleach the blood
red hue from these Witherless
Roses and adorn these flowers
with eternal elegance. May I use these items to make a Mystic Rose?
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特·瑪麗]
啊，看來您帶來了我需要的材料，可以將這些永恆玫瑰上的血紅褪去，賦予花朵永恆的優雅。
我可以開始製作水靈玫瑰了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
Thank you. Please
next; a moment while
I concentrate in order to
preserve the natural beauty
of these gorgeous flowers...
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特·瑪麗]
謝謝。請稍等，我需要集中精神，以保留這些美麗花朵原本的自然之美...

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
The rose truly is the
undisputed queen of all
flowers. All other flora must
humbly bow to its regal beauty.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特·瑪麗]
玫瑰無疑是百花之王。
其他所有花卉都必須向它尊貴的美麗低頭致敬。

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
There, it is finished.
Please remember to wear
your hair in an elegant and
refined manner when wearing
the Mystic Rose so as not to disgrace these beautiful flowers.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特·瑪麗]
好了，完成了。
佩戴水靈玫瑰時，請務必將頭髮梳理得優雅精緻，以免玷汙了這些美麗的花朵。

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
White roses with thorns
makes my heart beat with
unceasing trepidation. What
if I prick my finger and shed
blood on its snow white petals?
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特·瑪麗]
帶刺的白玫瑰讓我心跳加速，充滿無盡的忐忑。
萬一我刺破了手指，鮮血滴落在雪白的花瓣上怎麼辦？

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
I love roses, but it makes
me sad that their beauty
fades far too soon. And so,
I've found a way to preserve
the beauty of the roses, so
that it lasts for all eternity.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特·瑪麗]
我愛玫瑰，但它們的美麗消逝得太快，這讓我感到悲傷。
因此，我找到了一種方法，可以保留玫瑰的美麗，使其永恆不滅。

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
Do you love roses as well?
If you like, I can make a
^3131FFMystic Rose^000000 that you can wear
upon your crown. It's not easy
for me to create, but I believe that you would enjoy it greatly.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特·瑪麗]
您也愛玫瑰嗎？
如果您願意，我可以為您製作一朵^3131FF水靈玫瑰^000000，戴在您的髮間。
製作它並不容易，但我相信您會非常喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
Please bring me
^3131FF10 2 Carat Diamonds^000000,
^3131FF3 Witherless Roses^000000,
^3131FF1 White Dyestuffs^000000 and
^3131FF50,000 zeny^000000 if you would
like to have a Mystic Rose.
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特·瑪麗]
如果您想要一朵水靈玫瑰，請帶給我^3131FF10顆2克拉鑽石^000000、^3131FF3朵永恆玫瑰^000000、^3131FF1個白色染料^000000以及^3131FF50,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text:
[Margaret Mary]
White roses with thorns
makes my heart beat with
unceasing trepidation. What
if I prick my finger and shed
blood on its snow white petals?
scripts.translation:
[瑪格麗特·瑪麗]
帶刺的白玫瑰讓我心跳加速，充滿無盡的忐忑。

scripts.text: Er, I dunno.

scripts.text: Sure.

scripts.text:

Hats...?

[Zealotus]
Kneel, worm!
As ruler of this
Underground Prison,
I command all who step
into my private realm!
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
跪下，蟲子！
作為這座地下監獄的統治者，我命令所有踏入我私人領域的人！

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
Resist, and you shall be
punished! Grovel and kiss
my feet, and perhaps you
might be spared. Hohohohoho!
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
反抗者將受到懲罰！
跪下親吻我的腳，或許我會饒你一命。
呵呵呵呵呵！

scripts.text: Oh, your highness!
scripts.translation: 哦，殿下！

scripts.text: Whatever.
scripts.translation: 隨便吧

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
The submissive woman is
nothing but an ideal dream
for the arrogant male! A true
woman revels in her power to
have her man do her bidding!
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
順從的女性不過是傲慢男性的理想幻夢！
真正的女性會享受讓男人聽命於己的力量！

scripts.text: Yes, it's so true!
scripts.translation: 是的，太真實了！

scripts.text: Boooo!

[Zealotus]
However, in my lust for power, I may have inadventently crushed
the spirits of my beloved a little too harshly. His pride crumbled,
my man even cowers in front of the humans! It pains me to see it.
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
然而，在我對權力的渴望中，我可能不小心對我的愛人過於嚴厲了。
他的驕傲崩塌了，我的男人甚至在人類面前畏縮！
看到這一幕讓我很痛心。

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
It is beneath me to ask
this of you, but it will take
a human like you to make
him remember who he truly is,
a proud creature of darkness
who should fear only me!
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
讓你做這件事有失我的身份，但只有像你這樣的人才能讓他記起自己是誰，一個驕傲的黑暗生物，他應該只畏懼我！

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
Human. I offer you a small
share of my power if you can
take the pathetic, weeping lump
of monster crying in the corner
of this prison and make him
realize his true nature.
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
人類。如果你能讓那個蜷縮在監獄角落哭泣的可憐魔物意識到他的本性，我就分給你一小部分我的力量。

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
You dirty, dirty human...
How dare you have an 
opinion different than mine!

when all of your race shall
address me only as "queen."
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
你骯髒、骯髒的人類...
你竟敢持有與我不同的觀點！
沒關係。終有一天，你們整個種族都將只稱呼我為“女王”。

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
Mortal simpleton!
Bah! The mocking of
a boorish cur is worthless
to me. I have all the time in
the world to grind your pride
to dust beneath my heels.
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
愚蠢的凡人！
哼！粗俗之徒的嘲諷對我毫無價值。
我有的是時間，將你的驕傲在我的腳下碾成塵土。

scripts.text:

acting stubborn or refuses
to listen, feel free to take
drastic measures. Just think
of what I would do in your
place. Ohohohohoho~!
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
嗯。如果我的愛人表現固執或拒絕聽從，你可以採取果斷措施。
想想如果換成我會怎麼做。哦呵呵呵呵呵~！

scripts.text:

Phendark is certainly
back to his old self again,
thanks to your efforts, human.
Yes, his anger, his courage
and passion are all restored~
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]

多虧你的努力，人類，芬達克已經恢復了他原本的樣子。
是的，他的憤怒、勇氣和激情都回來了~

some items to form this minor
contract between you and me.

如我所承諾的，我將分給你一部分我的力量。
不過，我需要一些物品來締結你與我之間的這份小契約。

scripts.text:

^3131FF1 Cat's Eye^000000,
^3131FF1 Forbidden Red Candle^000000 and
^3131FF30 Worn-Out Magic Scrolls^000000.
Then, I can grant you a measure
of my power as I've promised.

我需要^3131FF1個貓眼石^000000、^3131FF1根紅色蠟燭^000000和^3131FF30張老舊魔法圖^000000。
這樣，我就能履行承諾，分給你一部分我的力量。

scripts.text:

brought what I need to
complete the contract
between you and me,
human. Let's begin...
scripts.translation:

看來你帶來了完成你我之間契約所需的物品，人類。
讓我們開始吧...

現在，將你的食指伸進我的手掌，以便我們完成這份契約的最後一步...

your soul, or anything
else for that matter.
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
嗯？你在害怕什麼？
這只是一個小契約，你並沒有把靈魂賣給我，或者其他任何東西。

scripts.text:

eternal contract with this

scripts.translation:

我，澤洛圖斯，作為此地的統治者，以這根紅色蠟燭封印這份永恆的契約。

人類，帶上這個面具，作為我們契約的永恆信物。

澤洛圖斯如是說！

peace, human. Behold,
the splendor of our realm!
Though, I do not blame you
if you have no interest in
commanding these Injustices...
scripts.translation:

啊，向你致以和平的問候，人類。
看啊，我們領地的輝煌！
不過，如果你對這些邪惡使者沒有指揮的興趣，我也不會責怪你...

scripts.text:
[Zealotus]
Thanks to your help,
my Phendark has returned
to his old, monstrously
passionate ways. Now I can
show him the stinging love
of my whip! Hohohohohoho!
scripts.translation:
[澤洛圖斯]
多虧你的幫助，我的芬達克恢復了他往日那充滿激情的怪誕模樣。現在我可以向他展示我鞭子的刺痛之愛啦！呵呵呵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Huh? Oh no!
Another h-human?!
P-please! S-stay away,
don't come near me!
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
什...什麼？！
又...又來人類了？！
求...求你！別靠近我，離我遠點！

scripts.text:

don't come near me!

什...什麼？！
又...又來人類了？！
求...求你！別靠近我，離我遠點！

[Phendark]
I... I swear!
I'm not carrying any
rare items or stuff you
can wear, so please don't
beat me! I... Oh my god, you
don't believe me, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
我...我發誓！
我沒帶什麼稀有物品或你能穿戴的東西，所以求你別打我！我...天哪，你肯定不信我吧？

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
You humans never leave
me alone! Why do you have
to bully me like this?! I'm
honestly not carrying anything
of value! Z-Zealotus, please!
Zealotus, heeeeeelp me~!
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
你們人類從來都不放過我！
為什麼非要這樣欺負我？！
我真的沒帶什麼值錢的東西！
澤...澤洛圖斯，求你了！
澤洛圖斯，救救我~！

scripts.text:
[{0}]

Aren't you supposed
to be a monster? You know
what Zealotus would do if
she were actually here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你真丟人！
你不是魔物嗎？
你知道如果澤洛圖斯真的在這裡，她會怎麼做嗎？

scripts.text:

^333333*Sniff...*^000000

Probably whip me.

^3355FFYou nonchalantly^000000
^3355FFbrandish your Whip.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你漫不經心地^000000
^3355FF揮舞著你的鞭子。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's right.

^3355FF*Snap!*
*Snap!*
*Crack crack crack!*
*Snap snap snap crack!*^000000

[Phendark]
Oh! That stinging pain
that burns with bloodlust!
It's almost as good as
Zealtos's whip of love!
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
噢！那種刺痛感燃燒著嗜血的本能！
簡直就像澤洛圖斯充滿愛意的鞭子一樣！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Zealotus...
She must be pissed
at me, but I just can't
stop being afraid of all
you humans! Damn it all!
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
澤洛圖斯...
她肯定在生我的氣，但我就是忍不住害怕你們這些人類！
該死啊！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Y-you again!
Why do you hound me?!
Th-there's nothing I can
give you, so please don't
hurt me! Oh, oh p-please...!
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
又...又是你！
你為什麼非要糾纏我？！
我...我沒有什麼能給你的，求求你別傷害我！
求求你...別這樣...

scripts.text: Feed him Dark Crystal Fragment.
scripts.translation: 喂他黑色水晶碎片

scripts.text: Threaten him.
scripts.translation: 威脅他

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
What...? You want
me to eat these?
It doesn't seem natural,
but if Rybio says I should,
it might not be that bad.
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
什...什麼？你想讓我吃這些？
雖然看起來很不自然，但如果裡比奧說應該吃，那可能也沒那麼糟糕。

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
What's supposed to
happen now? My inner
demon is supposed to
awaken by eating these?
That sounds ridiculous!
Though, I did just eat crystal.
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
接下來會發生什麼？
吃了這些，我體內的惡魔就會覺醒嗎？
這聽起來太荒謬了！
不過，我剛才確實吃了水晶。

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Wh-whoa. Ugh!
My chest! Something's
burning inside! I c-can't--!
Can't think straight... I'm...
Slowly... Losing my humanity!
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
哇...唔！
我的胸口！裡面有什麼在燃燒！我...我撐不住--！
腦子一片空白...我...
正在...失去人性！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Huh... Huuurg--!
Huk-huk! Heeeeh!
Heeeeeh! Waaoooooh!

[Phendark]
...
Grrrrr...!

[Phendark]
^333333*Pant pant*^000000
What... just...
What happened?

[{0}]
So what happens
if I don't decide not
to hurt you? Whatcha
gonna do then, huh?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如果我決定不傷害你呢？
那你打算怎麼辦，嗯？

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
S-stop it!
Just--Just stop it!
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
停...停下！
求你...求你停下！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Humans...
They're everywhere!
You guys--I can't...
You're torturing me!
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
人類...
到處都是！
你們這些傢伙--我受不了了...
你們在折磨我！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
My chest was on fire,
like I was, I dunno,
burning with anger or
something. It's gone
now, but what were
those crystals?
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
我的胸口像著了火一樣，就像...我不知道，像是被憤怒吞噬。
現在感覺消失了，但那些水晶是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
You again? Oh no,
you're not going to hurt
me or make me eat those
weird crystals again, are you?
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
又是你？天哪，你不會又要傷害我，或者逼我吃那些奇怪的水晶吧？

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
I don't think
congratulations are
in order, but I guess
that's good news to hear.
Still, what a surprise!
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
我覺得現在說恭喜還為時過早，不過聽到這個好訊息也不錯。
真是令人驚訝啊！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Hey...!
I don't know if
that's something
I want to hear about!
[{0}]
First of all,
what exactly sets
you apart from all the
other eligible monsters
that she can choose from?
Not like you're much better...
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
嘿...！
我可不想聽這種事！
[{0}]
首先，你和其他那些她可以挑選的合格魔物相比，到底有什麼特別之處？
你也沒好到哪裡去...

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Hey...!
I don't know if
that's something
I want to hear about!
[{0}]
I...
I was just kidding!
How could she hate
somebody like you?
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
嘿...！
我可不想聽這種事！
[{0}]
我...
我開玩笑的！
她怎麼可能憎恨你這樣的人？

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Hey...!
I don't know if
that's something
I want to hear about!
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
嘿...！
我可不想聽這種事！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
I can't believe
something like that!
Oh, that doesn't matter.
Zealotus is too good for me.
I'm not even worthy of tasting
the sting of her Love Whip.
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
我簡直不敢相信！
哦，這並不重要。
澤洛圖斯對我來說太優秀了。
我甚至不配品嚐她愛之鞭的刺痛。

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
...
......

N-no, that can't--

scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
...
......

scripts.text:
[Phendark]

supposed to mean?

[芬達克]
嗯...？
這是什麼意思？

scripts.text: Insult him.

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
...
......
Break his pride.
scripts.translation: 打擊他的自尊心

scripts.text: Tell him you were joking.
scripts.translation: 告訴他你在開玩笑

scripts.text:
^3131FF[{0}]^000000
I mean, there are guys
like Bloody Murderer out
there who are more evil
than you, and best of all,
not afraid of humans!
scripts.translation:
^3131FF[{0}]^000000
我是說，外面有像嗜血怪人那樣比你更邪惡的傢伙，而且最重要的是，他們不怕人類！

scripts.text: Go for the low blow.
scripts.translation: 進行人身攻擊

scripts.text: Try to salvage his confidence.
scripts.translation: 試圖挽回他的自信

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You know, me and Zealotus
were actually talking about
you recently. She told me that
the sight of you makes her
feel sick! I mean, what kind
of monster is afraid of humans?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道嗎，我和澤洛圖斯最近其實一直在談論你。她說看到你就覺得噁心！我是說，什麼樣的魔物會害怕人類啊？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now you've reached the
point where even Injustice
is manlier than you now,
if you know what I mean!
Hahahahahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
現在你甚至變得比邪惡使者還缺乏男子氣概了，如果你懂我意思的話！
哈哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
...
......

[Phendark]
GRRRRRR!
THAT'S ENOUGH!
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
吼吼吼吼！
夠了！

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
I don't care who the
hell she is, I'm going
to see Zealotus and give
that tramp a piece of my
mind! Grrrr! She'll be sorry!
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
我不管她是誰，我要去找澤洛圖斯，給那個蕩婦一點顏色看看！
吼！她死定了！

scripts.text:
^3131FF[{0}]^000000
But know that I think
about it, maybe you look
much tougher than that
Bloody Murderer guy.
scripts.translation:
^3131FF[{0}]^000000
不過話說回來，也許你看起來比那個嗜血怪人還要兇悍。

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
*Sniff sniff*
You really think so?
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
*吸鼻子*
你...真的這麼覺得嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...Yeeeeeah.

[{0}]
But now that I think
about it, you actually
are much better than all
those other monsters.
That stuff I said before?
I was just kidding you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不過仔細想想，你其實比那些魔物都要強得多。
我剛才說的話？
我只是在逗你玩。

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
^333333*Sniff!*^000000
You're...
Not helping!

[{0}]
I...
I was just kidding!
How could she hate
somebody like you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我...
我只是在開玩笑！
她怎麼可能討厭像你這樣的人呢？

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
No... No.
You're right.
I don't deserve love.
Not from Zealotus or
from anybody else...
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
不...不。
你說得對。
我不配得到愛。
無論是來自澤洛圖斯還是其他人...

scripts.text:
[Phendark]
Zealotus! How dare
she say those things
against me! Less manly
than Injustice?! I'll just
have to prove her wrong!
Out the way, pithy human!
scripts.translation:
[芬達克]
澤洛圖斯！她竟敢那樣說我！比邪惡使者還缺乏男子氣概？！
我一定要證明她是錯的！
讓開，渺小的人類！

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
You know, I usually just
run up and slash like crazy
once I see you humans, but
my heart's not in it today, so
I'm gonna give you just one
chance to run for your life.
scripts.translation:
[裡比奧]
你知道嗎，通常我一看到你們人類就會衝上去瘋狂揮砍，但今天我心情不好，所以給你一次逃命的機會。

scripts.text: Talk about Phendark.
scripts.translation: 談談芬達克

scripts.text: Run for your life.
scripts.translation: 逃命

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
What th--? You know the
same Phendark I know?
Dayam, that's weird. But
yeah, him and Zealotus have
some kind of... I dunno what
it is, actually. Um, love?
scripts.translation:
[裡比奧]
什...？你認識我認識的那個芬達克？
哇，真奇怪。不過是的，他和澤洛圖斯之間有點...我不知道那是什麼。嗯，愛情？

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
Anyway, Phendark has
been acting really weird
lately. I guess Zealotus
loved him to the point that
she abused him to the point
that he's scared of humans now.
scripts.translation:
[裡比奧]
總之，芬達克最近行為很古怪。我想澤洛圖斯愛他愛到虐待他，以至於他現在害怕人類了。

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
Huh. You know what'd help?
Dark Crystal Fragments. It's
worthless to humans, but if
creatures of darkness eat it,
it brings out more of their
inner demon. Scary, huh?
scripts.translation:
[裡比奧]
嗯。你知道什麼會有幫助嗎？
黑色水晶碎片。這對人類毫無價值，但如果黑暗生物吃了它，就會激發出它們內心的惡魔。很可怕，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
Since Phendark's pretty big, and he's acting like a total wuss, you
you should probably get him to eat ^3131FF369 Dark Crystal Fragments^000000. Don't
worry, you should be able to find those all over Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[裡比奧]
既然芬達克體型很大，而且表現得像個膽小鬼，你應該讓他吃^3131FF369個黑色水晶碎片^000000。
別擔心，你應該能在米德加爾特各地找到它們。

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
I dunno why a human
like you would want to
help one of us out, though.
What's in it for you, exactly?
scripts.translation:
[裡比奧]
不過，我搞不懂像你這樣的人類為什麼會想幫助我們。
你到底圖什麼？

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
That's right!
Run, get outta here!
If you're not fast enough,
I might eat you, human!
...Well... Probably not.
scripts.translation:
[裡比奧]
沒錯！
快跑，趕緊離開這裡！
如果你跑得不夠快，我可能會吃掉你，人類！
...嗯...大概不會吧。

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
I don't get why someone
like you, a seemingly heroic
adventurer, would want to help
out Phendark? Did Zealotus
blackmail you or something?
scripts.translation:
[裡比奧]
我不明白像你這樣看似英勇的冒險者，為什麼要幫助芬達克？
是澤洛圖斯威脅你了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
Well, you could
probably help him
by getting him to eat
^3131FF369 Dark Crystal Fragments^000000
to sort of stir up the demon
that sleeping within, you know?
scripts.translation:
[裡比奧]
嗯，你大概可以通過讓他吃^3131FF369個黑色水晶碎片^000000來激發他內心沉睡的惡魔，以此來幫助他，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
Feeding him all of those
Dark Crystal Fragments didn't
work? But that was supposed
to be foolproof! Dayam, what
the hell happened to Phendark's
inner demon?! Man oh man...
scripts.translation:
[裡比奧]
餵給他那麼多黑色水晶碎片都沒用嗎？但那應該是萬無一失的！
哇，芬達克內心的惡魔到底怎麼了？
天哪...

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
Well, I don't know what
else you could try. I mean,
maybe you could try motivating
him. Reverse psychology?
It's weird talking about this
with a human. Hahahaha~
scripts.translation:
[裡比奧]
嗯，我不知道你還能嘗試什麼。
我是說，也許你可以試著激勵他。
反向心理戰術？
和人類談論這些真奇怪。哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Rybio]
Phendark sure looks
tough, but I guess even
he isn't totally evil. Yeah.
We monsters aren't all
bad... Just mostly bad.
scripts.translation:
[裡比奧]
芬達克看起來很兇悍，但我想他也不是完全邪惡的。是的。
我們魔物不全是壞的...只是大部分很壞。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Oh man...
It's almost lunchtime,
but he hasn't come by
yet. Where could h--Oh!
Hello, welcome to Einbroch~
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
天哪...
快吃午飯了，但他還沒來。他在哪...哦！
你好，歡迎來到艾音布羅克~

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Wait a sec, that
Crunch Toast! You must
be the guy who helped out
my buddy, Kasis. I owe you
my gratitude since without your help, I wouldn't eat lunch!
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
等一下，那個土司！
你一定是幫助了我朋友卡西斯的那個人。
我很感激你，因為如果沒有你的幫助，我就沒飯吃了！

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
It sounds like Kasis
has been having business
troubles lately, but I'm sure
he'll weather it out. I just don't know what's taking him so long
to get here. I'm sooo hungry!
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
聽起來卡西斯最近生意不太好，但我相信他能挺過去的。我只是不知道他為什麼這麼久還沒來。
我好餓啊！

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
By any chance, are you
heading to Juno? I have
a favor to ask if you're
going there. Or did you
need help finding your
way around this city?
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
請問，你是要去朱諾嗎？如果你要去的話，我有件事想拜託你。
或者你需要我幫你在這座城市裡找路嗎？

scripts.text: Sure, I'm heading to Juno.
scripts.translation: 好的，我要去朱諾

scripts.text: I need help finding my way around!
scripts.translation: 我需要幫忙找路！

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Well, if you're going to
Juno and you're not busy,
would you visit a pastry
chef named Kasis for me?
He's an old friend and I'm
a little worried about him.
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
嗯，如果你要去朱諾而且不忙的話，能幫我拜訪一下名叫卡西斯的糕點廚師嗎？
他是我的老朋友，我有點擔心他。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Usually, he sends us
lunches around this time
without fail, but since lunch
hasn't arrived yet, I can't help but wonder, ''What happened?''
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
通常，他都會在這個時間準時給我們送午餐，但既然午餐還沒到，我不禁會想，“發生什麼事了？”

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Of course, I'd be lying if
I said my hunger didn't factor
into my concern for his welfare. Anyway, if you have the time,
you can find Kasis in Juno's
Bakery. Thanks, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
當然，如果我說我的飢餓感沒有影響我對他安危的擔憂，那是在撒謊。總之，如果你有時間的話，你可以在朱諾的麵包店找到卡西斯。謝謝，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
First of all, if you
go just outside of the
Airport, you can find
Guides that can tell you
about all the important
places of interest in Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
首先，如果你走出機場，你可以找到嚮導，他們可以告訴你艾音布羅克所有重要的景點。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Now, if you want to take
a rest before or after a
flight on one of the Airships,
you can use the passenger
lounge on the second floor.
It's a good tip to know~
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
現在，如果你想在乘坐飛空艇之前或之後休息一下，你可以使用二樓的候機室。
這是一個不錯的小貼士~

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Did you have any
other questions to ask
me while you're here?
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
你在這裡還有別的問題要問我嗎？

scripts.text: Can I take a picture with you?
scripts.translation: 能和你合個影嗎？

scripts.text: About Einbroch
scripts.translation: 關於艾音布羅克

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Pardon me?
I don't hear that
request often, but
I suppose it couldn't
do any harm to pose
for just one picture.
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
請問？
這種要求我還真很少聽到，不過拍一張照片應該也無妨。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Cheese~
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
茄子~

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
You know, it's hard to
believe that Einbroch has
become a major industrial
so quickly. I guess it's the
result of the demand for the
ores mined over in Einbech.
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
你知道嗎，很難相信艾音布羅克這麼快就成為了一個主要的工業城市。
我想這大概是因為艾音貝赫那邊開採礦石的需求所致吧。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Although Einbech and Einbroch
can't survive without each other, Einbech is in a pretty sorry state
compared to Einbroch. If you've
ever been there, you know what
I mean. It's almost tragic.
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
雖然艾音貝赫和艾音布羅克誰也離不開誰，但和艾音布羅克相比，艾音貝赫的狀況相當糟糕。
如果你去過那裡，你就明白我的意思了。
簡直有點令人悲哀。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Most of the prosperity of
this city is attributed to the
productivity of the factories.
But along with great wealth,
these factories have also
brought pollution problems.
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
這座城市的繁榮主要歸功於工廠的高生產力。
但伴隨著巨大的財富，這些工廠也帶來了汙染問題。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
If you hear the
Smog Alert, you should
run to safety as quickly
as you can! It's dangerous
to be out in the open when
the pollution levels are high!
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
如果你聽到煙霧警報，應該儘快跑到安全的地方！
在汙染水平高的時候待在戶外是很危險的！

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Well then, I hope
that you enjoy your
travels here in Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
那麼，希望你在艾音布羅克的旅行愉快。

scripts.text:
[Kirishu]
Have a good time in
Einbroch, adventurer.
I hope you enjoy your
travels here in the
Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation:
[基裡舒]
祝你在艾音布羅克玩得開心，冒險者。
希望你在修瓦魯茲巴魯德共和國的旅行愉快。
